name: Country Ranch Food Products
old_description: At Country Ranch Foods, we pride ourselves on our adaptability and capability to bring to market a wide range of foodservice and institutional foods. Whether it’s crafting savory chilis for a restaurant chain in the southeast United states or producing Chicken Mojo for an exporter on the west coast, we ensure that every product leaving our facility meets the highest standards.
about:
Country Ranch Foods operates from Marietta, Georgia. The company is owned and operated by two Georgia natives, Ed Vanderslice Jr. and Michael Karakos. The founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The company serves as a private label food production partner, manufacturing a range of foodservice and institutional products such as savory chilis for restaurant chains in the southeastern United States and Chicken Mojo for exporters on the West Coast. Specific details about facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Its customers include restaurant chains, foodservice distributors, and exporters. The company references work with a restaurant chain in the southeast and an exporter on the west coast, though distribution partners are not named. Industries served encompass foodservice, institutional dining, and food export markets.

Country Ranch Foods emphasizes adaptability and capability in bringing diverse products to market, citing a culture of integrity, reliability, and food safety. The owners state that enduring customer relationships are built on trust and proven performance.
